socialmediadesc1: Portuguese brands needed a steady stream of on-brand social content, so over the course of a year I designed more than 1,000 social media posts across a wide range of clients.
socialmediadesc2: The brands ranged from clothing labels to real estate agencies, each with a different tone and visual identity to match.
standsdesc1: An industrial client needed a consistent presence across several international trade fairs, so I designed and produced elaborate stands built to travel and hold up across multiple venues.
standsdesc2: The client exhibited in France — specifically Douai, Angers, and Lyon (pictured above) — with the design adapted to each fair's layout.
outdoorsdesc1: A new medical clinic needed a strong public presence for its opening, so I developed outdoor advertising designed to translate their branding into a large-format public ad.
outdoorsdesc2: The example above was created specifically for the opening of the new clinic.
fbadsdesc1: Social clients needed advertising content built specifically for fast-moving formats, so I produced short-form video and image ads tailored for Reels and Stories.
fbadsdesc2: Click the image above to see one of these ads in motion.
storefrontdesc1: A clinic needed a full storefront refresh to modernize how it presented itself to the street, so I redesigned the entire front — including illuminated panels covering the full facade.
storefrontdesc2: The image above shows the before-and-after of the clinic's frontage.
webpagebannerdesc1: Clients needed a strong visual opening for their web pages — the first thing a visitor sees — so I produced banner imagery and video built specifically for that role.
